environment.notes: Air temperature is an estimate of a typical race afternoon (late July, Ardennes, about 450 m up). Pressure is the ISA value at the lap's mean altitude. Session times are the 2025 event's local start times.

dem.filter: opening 60 m, moving average 90 m, Gaussian sigma 20 m

source.estimates: Widths, banking, kerbs, run-off kinds nearest the track, barrier types and offsets not mapped in OpenStreetMap, pit-lane widths, limit lines, boxes and grid slots are authored estimates.

timingLine.source: FIA 2025 Belgian circuit map: the map's drawn track fitted to this centreline with tools/research/map_fit.py (similarity transform, median miss 4.7 m) and the control-line tick projected onto it; 128.6 m before the start line. Under the same fit the speed-trap tick lands 2 m and the sector 2 tick 5 m from their stored positions, and the sector 1 tick 15 m (its centroid is pulled off the track by the label), hence +/- 15 m.
